notes.title: 🐾 Derpy’s Big Adventure: We’re Heading to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re beyond excited to share that “Cat Me If You Can” will be showcased at Gamescom 2025 as part of the Indie Arena Booth![/h3][p][/p][p]It’s your chance to play the [i][b]Cat Me If You Can[/b][/i] demo & snap a pic with our fluffiest star.
[/p][p][b]In case you haven’t met him yet, this is Derpy, the derpiest cat you’ll meet at Gamescom (and yes, he loves selfies). 🐱[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479848/c511c6240cc85044407a22e1fa271d86e39e8f1e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]When & Where:[/b] [/h3][p]📅 August 20–24, 2025 [/p][p]📍 Koelnmesse, Cologne – Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s in store?[/b][/h3][p]We’re bringing a brand-new demo with exclusive gameplay content, plus a few fluffy surprises. You’ll get the chance to:[/p][list][*][p]🎮 Play the game before release[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 Meet the Cosmic Stag team in person[/p][/*][*][p]🐱 Meet (and take a photo with!) our resident plushie superstar, Derpy the Cat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]📸 Tag your pics with:[/p][list][*][p][b]#CatMeIfYouCan[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]#DerpyAtGamescom[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]for a chance to be featured on our socials.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Why we’re so excited:[/b] [/h3][p]Gamescom is one of the largest gaming events in the world, and being part of it is a dream come true for our small team. We’ve poured so much love into [b]Cat Me If You Can[/b], and we can’t wait to see players’ first reactions to our new content.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How you can join the fun:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]💜 Wishlist Cat Me If You Can on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]📲 Follow us on social media for live Gamescom updates[/p][/*][*][p]🐾 Stop by our booth and say hi to Derpy![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We’re counting down the days, see you in Cologne![/b][/p][p]The Cosmic Stag Team[/p]

notes.title: Cat Me If You Can is heading to Gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to announce that Cat Me If You Can will be part of Gamescom 2025 at the Indie Arena Booth![/h3][p][/p][p]Catch us at [b]Hall 10.2[/b] at [b]Koelnmesse, Cologne, Germany [/b][/p][p]🗓 [b]August 20–24, 2025[/b] [/p][p]📍 [b]Indie Arena Booth – Hall 10.2 [/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]✨ What to Expect:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ll be showcasing [b]exciting new updates[/b], [b]exclusive content[/b], and a [b]hands-on playable demo.[/b] 
Including a [b]brand new map[/b] and lots of [b]fluffy surprises[/b]! 👀 [/p][p]If you're attending, don’t miss your chance to [b]sneak by, find some hidden cats[/b], and meet the devs behind the whiskers. We’d love to connect with you in person!
[/p][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ojc-RmYKGWg"]Check out the official Indie Arena Booth Trailer featuring the many amazing indie titles that will be with us at Gamescom! [/url][/h3][p]
Join our Discord if you want to stay up to date and follow along with the development: [url="https://discord.gg/2gzUWmbadJ" style="button"]JOIN THE DISCORD[/url][/p][p]
Cheers
[b]The Cosmic Stag Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Announcing Cat Me If You Can!
notes.content:
[h1]We are proudly announcing our new game: [i][b]Cat Me If You Can[/b][/i][/h1]

[previewyoutube=hb6PjzZXQTw;full][/previewyoutube]

Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.


[h2][b]Wishlist now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170490/Cat_Me_If_You_Can/

[i][b]Cat Me If You Can[/b][/i] is set to launch in Q3 this year with a public demo coming prior in Q2. We can't wait for you to play and enjoy this game and are looking forward to all your feedback 😻

Join our Discord if you want to follow along with the development: https://discord.gg/2gzUWmbadJ

Cheers
The Cosmic Stag Games Team
